runner_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/everruns
report_dir=/tmp/platform-final-2026-10-24
study=/workspace/everruns/evals/platform-capability/target/debug/platform_capability
export EVERRUNS_EVAL_MODE=offline EVERRUNS_EVAL_TRIALS=1
run_batch() {
  local model_label=$1 model=$2 round=$3 surface=$4 tag=$5
  local base="$report_dir/$model_label-$tag-$surface-round-$round"
  printf '%s START %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$base"
  local status=0
  EVERRUNS_EVAL_TARGETS="$model" EVERRUNS_EVAL_SURFACE="$surface" \
    "$study" --run --tag "$tag" --runs-report "$base.jsonl" > "$base.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$base.exit"
  printf '%s END status=%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$status" "$base"
  if [[ ! -s "$base.jsonl" ]]; then
    tail -20 "$base.log"
    exit 1
  fi
}
printf 'START final bounded mutation smoke\n'
EVERRUNS_EVAL_TARGETS=meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor EVERRUNS_EVAL_SURFACE=native-bounded \
  "$study" --run --sample surface-update-description,surface-batch-update \
  --runs-report "$report_dir/muse-mutation-smoke.jsonl" > "$report_dir/muse-mutation-smoke.log" 2>&1
printf 'END final bounded mutation smoke PASS\n'
for round in 1 2 3; do
  case "$round" in
    1) surfaces=(cli native-bounded native-eager) ;;
    2) surfaces=(native-bounded native-eager cli) ;;
    3) surfaces=(native-eager cli native-bounded) ;;
  esac
  for surface in "${surfaces[@]}"; do
    run_batch muse meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor "$round" "$surface" surface-comparison
  done
done
for surface in cli native-bounded native-eager; do
  run_batch luna openai/gpt-6-luna 1 "$surface" surface-comparison
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
  case "$round" in
    1) surfaces=(cli native-bounded native-eager) ;;
    2) surfaces=(native-bounded native-eager cli) ;;
    3) surfaces=(native-eager cli native-bounded) ;;
  esac
  for surface in "${surfaces[@]}"; do
    run_batch muse meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor "$round" "$surface" surface-scale
  done
done
